verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-agent platform with content extraction, so automatic image captioning is a fair question for it. The pack documents converting URLs into HTML, JSON or markdown, but nothing about generating captions or alt-text descriptions for images. Text conversion of a page is an adjacent feature and does not show that visual content is captioned for a text-only model.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
